## Appearance

Nell features a small pointed chin, grey eyes that shine like stars in the night sky, and large, distinctive eyes. Her long, thick, bright red hair was briefly dyed green in her youth following a disastrous attempt to change its color. She also possesses an extraordinarily lovely nose.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Nell is a highly imaginative and romantic individual who constantly escapes into vivid fantasy realms and daydreams. Though she possesses a fiery temper and occasionally acts impulsively without thinking, she is fiercely honest, courageously admitting her mistakes and facing her punishments directly. She is deeply affectionate, intensely loyal to her friends, and places immense value on deep emotional connections and romantic beauty over cold prose.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021), [v1 c5 P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 c14 P38](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0038), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P36](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0036), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c20 P27](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0027), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033), [v2 c28 P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075)_

## History

Nell Harcourt was born in Harborough, Nova Scotia, to schoolteacher Edmund Harcourt and Bertha Harcourt. After being orphaned, she was sent to Grey Shutters on St. Brendan's Island by mistake when an orphan boy had been expected. Despite initial misunderstandings, she was taken in by Thirza and established a lifelong friendship with Isolde Pembroke. At Brierley school, Nell was known for her brilliant imagination, her feud with Hugh Carrow after he pulled her plait, and her academic achievements, ultimately winning the Avery scholarship. Postponing college to assist Thirza, she worked as the schoolteacher in Brierley for two years. Afterwards, Nell attended Redmond College, where she earned literary recognition by winning a short story contest with 'Evadne's Atonement' and publishing work in magazines. During her time at college, she rejected marriage proposals from Barney Pullen and the romantic Cyril. Upon completing her studies and putting geometry behind her, Nell prepared for her upcoming marriage to a physician.
